findings.name: Tight line height on running text
findings.fix: Use 1.45 to 1.7 for body copy; tighten only headings and single-line labels.

findings.name: Wide letter spacing on running text
findings.fix: Reset body tracking to the face's default; keep wide tracking for short uppercase labels only.

findings.name: Justified text without hyphenation
findings.fix: Use text-align: start, or add hyphens: auto with a lang attribute and a measure of 60 characters or more.

findings.name: transition: all
findings.fix: List the properties that should move, usually opacity, transform, color or box-shadow.

findings.name: Bounce or overshoot easing
findings.fix: Use a decelerating curve such as cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) and shorten the duration.

findings.name: Focus outline removed with no replacement

findings.name: Hard offset block shadow

findings.name: Neutral gray text on a colored ground

findings.name: Web font without font-display
findings.fix: Add font-display: swap (or optional for decorative faces) to every @font-face, and preload the one or two faces used above the fold.

findings.name: Coloured radial haze behind a section
findings.fix: Let the surface stand plain, or shift the ground a step lighter or darker. If a section needs emphasis, give it a real image, a border or more space.

findings.name: Blob or torn edge drawn with clip-path
findings.fix: Ship the shape as an image with transparency, or drop it. Keep clip-path for geometry: a cut corner, a diagonal, a hexagon.

findings.name: Image buried under an opaque wash
findings.fix: Lower the wash below 0.9 alpha, use a blend mode, or delete the image and keep the flat colour you are actually showing.

findings.name: Hairline border plus a wide soft shadow on cards
findings.fix: Pick one edge for the card family: a defined 1px border or a soft shadow with a short vertical offset. Keep both only for a popover or dialog that truly floats.

findings.name: Decorative blinking text cursor
findings.fix: Remove the fake caret. Real inputs draw their own. If the product is a terminal or editor, show a real one in a product screenshot.

findings.name: Running text set in capitals
findings.fix: Set running text in sentence case. Keep uppercase for labels of a few words, and add a little tracking when you do.
